channel.title: DarkLab Security — Notes
channel.description: Independent research notes on AI security, capability evaluation and agent control.

item.title: Rules of engagement as a control signal
item.description: A design note for monitoring authorised offensive-cyber agents. It pairs a rules-of-engagement check with a suspicion score for agents that reach beyond their task.

item.title: A weak monitor, and an attacker that never landed
item.description: A small trusted-monitoring experiment in ControlArena. A Llama-3.1-8B monitor screening code for backdoors did modestly on replayed data. The live attack round taught me more about eval design than about the monitor.

item.title: A regex is not a rules of engagement
item.description: Lessons from putting guardrails on an autonomous pentest agent, and why a pattern-matching classifier is the wrong kind of control for a tool-using model.
